design_philosophy.aesthetic: High-Tech Operational, Palantir Gotham-inspired, Dense, Precision-first
core_principles: Information Density > Whitespace: Maximize data visibility per pixel.
Operational Transparency: Show the AI's 'brain' (traces, confidence scores).
Status is Color: Color is used ONLY to indicate state (risk, progress, alert).
Sharpness: No soft shadows. Use 1px borders and distinct contrasts.

usage_rules: Use 'Space Grotesk' for all section headers and major KPIs.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL data values, IDs, timestamps, and JSON traces.
Use 'Inter' for long-form reading text (policy descriptions).
Headings should often be uppercase with wide tracking.

structure.container: flex h-screen w-full overflow-hidden bg-[#060709] text-[#e2e8f0]

button.primary: bg-[#3b82f6] hover:bg-[#3b82f6]/90 text-white rounded-none font-medium text-sm px-4 py-2 uppercase tracking-wide
button.secondary: bg-[#141820] border border-[#232b3d] hover:bg-[#1a1f2e] text-[#e2e8f0] rounded-none text-sm px-4 py-2
button.danger: bg-[#ef4444]/10 border border-[#ef4444]/50 text-[#ef4444] hover:bg-[#ef4444]/20 rounded-none

input.base: bg-[#0a0c12] border border-[#232b3d] text-[#e2e8f0] rounded-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#3b82f6] focus:border-[#3b82f6] placeholder:text-[#4a5568]

badge.base: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-none text-xs font-mono font-medium border

sidebar.container: w-[260px] bg-[#0a0c12] border-r border-[#1a1f2e] flex flex-col h-full
sidebar.item: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-[#8892a4] hover:text-[#e2e8f0] hover:bg-[#0f1218] border-l-2 border-transparent hover:border-[#3b82f6] transition-all

agent_pipeline.wrapper: relative flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 bg-[#0a0c12] border border-[#1a1f2e]
agent_pipeline.card: relative pl-4 py-3 pr-3 bg-[#0f1218] border border-[#1a1f2e] flex items-start gap-3
agent_pipeline.connector_line: absolute left-[19px] top-10 bottom-[-16px] w-[2px] bg-[#1a1f2e]
agent_pipeline.status_icon_wrapper: relative z-10 flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-[#0a0c12] border border-[#232b3d]

decision_panel.container: bg-[#0a0c12] border-2 border-dashed p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICTLY FOLLOW THE COLOR PALETTE. Do not introduce new grays or blues.
Use 'Space Grotesk' for Headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for all data/numbers.
Implement the Sidebar as fixed (w-[260px]) on desktop, collapsible on mobile.
The 'Agent Pipeline' is the core visual. Use the 'specific_components.agent_pipeline' styles.
Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. NO EMOJIS.
For the Risk Gauge, use a simple SVG implementation or a library like 'recharts' radial bar if needed, but custom SVG is preferred for strict control.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
The 'Decision Panel' must change its border color based on the verdict (Green=Pay, Red=Deny, Amber=Review).
Do NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it 'rounded-sm' or 'rounded-none' for that sharp operational look.
Stream the agent reasoning text using a typewriter effect if possible, or just append text chunk by chunk.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts. This is a dense dashboard.
Create depth through 1px borders, not heavy shadows.
Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors), never 'transition-all'.
Maximize the use of the 12-column grid.
Always check contrast ratios. The text is #e2e8f0 on #060709 (Passes AAA).
